description: Pre-EC2 corpus anchors recomputed under PRE-REGISTRATION.md A4: the recovery term measured over the span recovery traffic actually occupied, instead of backlogAtRestore/tDrain.
why: tDrain is the first second at which recoveryRemaining reaches 0, which lands after the last recovery request was issued. Dividing an exact backlog by a window padded with that dead tail understates the recovery rate.
scope: Every last-SAFE anchor STATUS.md marks valid.
liveTerm: Measured from the trace on both sides (live arrivals over their span), so the only thing differing between the OLD and A4 columns is the recovery estimator.
finding: The correction is NOT uniform: it scales with (tail / tDrain) x recovery share. Short drains with long tails move most (c10/C0 +0.0133, c50/C0 +0.0096); long drains with short tails barely move (c10/C1 +0.0010, c50/C1 +0.0015). It therefore does not cancel in any comparison and must be applied to both sides.
